name: gramsetu
description: GramSetu - Bridging Villages to Markets. Rural Digital Marketplace.

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('client/dist')) { fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true}); }"
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix client run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install

author: GramSetu Community
